Messages.Author: Nosk
Messages.Body:
Hi!

I have a doubt about the meaning of "Direct actions" on Corpse balloon.

A vampire of my prey is bleeding their prey at +1 stealth. I have a vampire with a corpse balloon attached to it (at superior VIS).

Could I play an Eagle Sight to attempt to block that bleed using the intercept of the Corpse Balloon? That bleed is a  action, but is not directed at me, does it matters?

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
The bleed is directed at your grand-prey, so yes, it is directed.
